import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.isotonic import IsotonicRegression
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Load sample submission template
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Prepare features - only using text column for both train and test
y = train["Insult"].values
text = train["Comment"].values

# Split training data - hold-out validation that is NEVER used for training final model
X_train_val, X_val, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    text, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

# Word-level TF-IDF features
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, min_df=1, max_df=0.95, lowercase=True
)
X_train_val_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_val)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

# Character-level TF-IDF features
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 4), max_features=50000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)
X_train_val_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_val)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

# Combine word and character features
X_train_val_combined = hstack([X_train_val_word, X_train_val_char])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])

# Convert sparse to dense for XGBoost
X_train_val_d = X_train_val_combined.toarray()
X_val_d = X_val_combined.toarray()

# Initialize models with best hyperparameters from previous solution
lr = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=2000, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, class_weight="balanced"
)
gbr = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=4,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    verbose=False,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    use_label_encoder=False,
)

# Train models on validation split only for calibration
lr.fit(X_train_val_d, y_train_val)
gbr.fit(X_train_val_d, y_train_val)

# Get raw probabilities from both models on validation set
lr_proba = lr.predict_proba(X_val_d)[:, 1]
gbr_proba = gbr.predict_proba(X_val_d)[:, 1]

# Calibrate probabilities using isotonic regression
lr_calibrated = (
    IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds="clip")
    .fit(y_val.reshape(-1), lr_proba)
    .predict(y_val.reshape(-1))
)
gbr_calibrated = (
    IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds="clip")
    .fit(y_val.reshape(-1), gbr_proba)
    .predict(y_val.reshape(-1))
)

# Calculate calibration-based ensemble weights (higher weight for better calibrated model)
lr_cal_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, lr_calibrated)
gbr_cal_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, gbr_calibrated)
weight_lr = lr_cal_val / (lr_cal_val + gbr_cal_val)
weight_gbr = gbr_cal_val / (lr_cal_val + gbr_cal_val)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set
lr_pred_val = lr.predict_proba(X_val_d)[:, 1]
gbr_pred_val = gbr.predict_proba(X_val_d)[:, 1]
val_pred_calibrated = weight_lr * lr_pred_val + weight_gbr * gbr_pred_val
val_pred_calibrated = np.clip(val_pred_calibrated, 0, 1)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred_calibrated)
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC (calibrated ensemble): {val_auc:.4f}")
print(f"Calibration weights - LR: {weight_lr:.4f}, XGB: {weight_gbr:.4f}")

# Retrain on full training data for final submission
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.transform(text)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.transform(text)
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_train_d = X_train_combined.toarray()
lr.fit(X_train_d, y)
gbr.fit(X_train_d, y)

# Predict on test set
test_text = test["Comment"].values
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_text)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_text)
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])
X_test_d = X_test_combined.toarray()
test_pred_lr = lr.predict_proba(X_test_d)[:, 1]
test_pred_gbr = gbr.predict_proba(X_test_d)[:, 1]
test_pred = weight_lr * test_pred_lr + weight_gbr * test_pred_gbr
test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 0, 1)

# Prepare submission - MUST match sample_submission_null.csv column order and names
# Expected columns based on data overview: Insult (predicted), Date, Comment
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Insult": test_pred,
        "Date": test["Date"].values,
        "Comment": test["Comment"].values,
    }
)

submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with correct column order")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Prediction range: [{test_pred.min():.4f}, {test_pred.max():.4f}]")
print(f"Feature types: Word n-grams + Character n-grams + Isotonic Calibration")

This atomic change focuses on post-calibration without altering features or hyperparameters, making it easily evaluable.
